data.title: Junior Product Builder - AI & Automation
data.description:
Über uns

Actura ist ein spezialisierter Dienstleister im Gesundheitswesen – von Kliniken für Kliniken. Wir übernehmen operative Verantwortung in den Bereichen Prozessmanagement, Personal, Einkauf, Controlling, Buchhaltung, Marketing, IT und Management. Unser Ansatz ist pragmatisch und ergebnisorientiert: Nicht die Beratung, sondern die direkte Umsetzung steht im Mittelpunkt. Mit einem erfahrenen Team aus dem Gesundheitswesen helfen wir Krankenhäusern, wirtschaftlich zukunftsfähig zu werden – gemeinsam, pragmatisch und erfolgsgetrieben.

Dein Impact

Wir suchen keinen klassischen Softwareentwickler.
Wir suchen jemanden, der Geschäftsmodelle, Prozesse und Zahlen versteht – und moderne AI-, Automation- und Development-Tools nutzt, um daraus funktionierende digitale Lösungen zu bauen.
AI und Automation müssen bei uns mehr können als eine gute Demo. Sie müssen im Alltag funktionieren, Arbeit abnehmen und sich sauber in bestehende Prozesse integrieren.
Du arbeitest nah an Geschäftsführung, Fachbereichen und Kunden und baust Lösungen von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz.

Konkret bedeutet das:

  • Digitale Tools und Anwendungen entwickeln und weiterentwickeln

  • Geschäfts- und Verwaltungsprozesse automatisieren

  • AI-gestützte Workflows für Dokumente, Daten und wiederkehrende Aufgaben bauen

  • Microsoft 365, APIs und weitere Systeme intelligent verbinden

  • Datenflüsse, Reporting- und Analyseprozesse automatisieren

  • Geschäftsprozesse und Anforderungen in funktionierende digitale Lösungen übersetzen

  • Lösungen vom Prototyp bis zum produktiven Einsatz bringen

  • UI und UX mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch gestalten

  • Zwischen Geschäftsführung, Fachbereich und Technik übersetzen

  • Eng mit unseren Kunden arbeiten und Lösungen auch im operativen Umfeld umsetzen

Was uns überzeugt

  • Starkes analytisches und strukturiertes Denken

  • Gutes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis

  • Erste Erfahrung in einem analytisch geprägten Umfeld, z. B. Beratung, Wirtschaftsprüfung, Finance, Operations oder Healthcare

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit AI-, Automation- und modernen Development-Tools

  • Eigene Erfahrung im Bau von Tools, Workflows, Automatisierungen oder Prototypen

  • Grundverständnis für APIs, Datenbanken, Datenflüsse und Systemintegrationen

  • Verständnis dafür, dass wir mit sensiblen Daten und in einem regulierten Umfeld arbeiten

  • Sehr gutes Gespür für UI, UX und digitale Produkte

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation, Tempo und Lust auf Verantwortung

  • Sicheres, professionelles Auftreten – intern wie beim Kunden

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch zur internen und externen Kommunikation

Unser Versprechen an Dich

  • Umsetzung statt PowerPoint. Du baust Lösungen, die tatsächlich eingesetzt werden.

  • Massiven Gestaltungsspielraum. Die Rolle ist neu und du kannst mitprägen, wie wir AI und Automation bei Actura einsetzen.

  • Direkten Zugang zu den Gründern. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und unmittelbares Feedback.

  • Früh Verantwortung. Wenn etwas funktioniert, setzen wir es ein.

  • Ein kleines Team mit hohem Tempo. Wenig Hierarchie, viel Eigenständigkeit.

  • Reale Probleme statt Demo-Cases. Du arbeitest an konkreten Herausforderungen aus unserem operativen Alltag.

  • Die Chance, einen neuen Bereich mit aufzubauen.

  • Flexibilität. Wir suchen bundesweit – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit.

data.title: Decorative Accessories/Home Decor Designer - home decor brand - 100% remote - part-/full time
data.description:
We’re looking for a talented Interior Designer with a strong product and decor mindset to join Noro Arts (https://noro-arts.com/en-eu), an established direct-to-consumer home decor brand, on a long-term basis.

Noro Arts creates distinctive wooden home decor for customers primarily in the US, with a strong focus on decorative wall art, three-dimensional wall pieces, sculptures and freestanding decorative objects.

We’re looking for someone who understands the aesthetic and product style of Noro Arts and has ideally already designed similar physical home decor products.

The ideal candidate combines a strong eye for interiors, shapes, materials and aesthetics with the ability to turn creative ideas into commercially successful products. This is not a traditional interior design role focused on designing spaces, but a hands-on opportunity to develop actual home decor products from concept to launch.

Tasks

Your main responsibility will be to develop new decor products by thinking from the perspective of the room and the customer.

You’ll identify opportunities for products that feel missing from today’s interiors — pieces that complete a space, elevate a room and have strong commercial potential.

Ideas can come from interior trends, market and competitor research, existing bestsellers or your own creative direction.

From there, you’ll take concepts through the full development process:

  • Develop new decor concepts with a strong focus on how they work within real interiors

  • Create and visualize ideas using AI image-generation tools

  • Test concepts in realistic room settings and different interior styles

  • Translate aesthetic ideas into clear product directions

  • Collaborate with CAD designers to turn concepts into manufacturable designs

  • Work with suppliers and factories throughout sampling and development

  • Coordinate with the content and advertising teams to prepare products for launch

  • Manage several product concepts and development projects in parallel

Requirements

  • A background in interior design, supported by a strong portfolio

  • Hands-on experience with AI image generation, using tools such as Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, Flux or similar

  • A strong eye for styling, proportions, materials, composition and what works within a room

  • Genuine interest in designing physical decor products and objects — not only spaces

  • Ability to translate an aesthetic idea into a concrete product concept that can be manufactured and sold

  • Highly organized, reliable and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously

  • Fluent English

Strong Plus

  • Experience designing custom furniture, decor objects or accessories

  • Experience working with wood, handcrafted products or similar materials

  • A strong understanding of US interior and home decor trends, such as organic modern, Japandi or mid-century

  • Experience with 3D or CAD tools, such as SketchUp, Rhino, Blender or similar

  • Experience collaborating with makers, factories, manufacturers or suppliers

  • Experience with product sampling and development iterations

Benefits

  • 🌍 100% remote – work from anywhere

  • ⏰ Flexible setup – part-time or full-time both possible

  • 🎨 High creative ownership over new products and design directions

  • 🏡 Opportunity to combine interior design with physical product development

  • 🤖 AI-first creative workflow, using modern tools for ideation and visualization

  • 🚀 High level of ownership from the first idea through product launch

  • 📈 Steep learning curve across interiors, product development, eCommerce and performance-driven launches

  • 🤝 International, entrepreneurial team with fast decision-making and close collaboration

  • 📦 Direct exposure to the full product lifecycle, from concept and sampling to content, advertising and launch

  • 🔄 Long-term collaboration with consistent opportunities to develop new products

  • 🚀 Start as soon as possible

If you’re an interior designer who enjoys thinking beyond spaces and wants to create physical decor products that become part of how people style their homes, I’d be happy to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV, portfolio and a few examples of interiors, products or custom pieces you’ve personally developed.

data.title: PHP-Entwickler / Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung (m/w/d) | Vollzeit
data.description:
Seit über 14 Jahren entwickeln wir bei TenMedia Individualsoftware für Mittelstand, öffentliche Hand und KRITIS-Betreiber. Unsere Software läuft dort, wo Ausfälle keine Option sind: in Behörden, bei kritischen Infrastrukturen und im Mittelstand.

Wir suchen dich als erfahrenen PHP-Entwickler / Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung (m/w/d), der genau in diesen Projekten zu Hause sein will. Du entwickelst neue Anwendungen von A bis Z mit, übernimmst Verantwortung für laufende Systeme und bringst Legacy-Anwendungen auf aktuelle Stände. Weil wir betreiben, was wir bauen, endet deine Arbeit nicht mit dem Go-live: Du siehst über Jahre, was aus deinem Code wird, und echte Kunden nutzen ihn täglich. Die Stelle ist dabei auf Entwicklung angelegt, auch auf deine: Wer Verantwortung übernimmt, wächst bei uns zum Lead Developer, langfristig bis zur CTO-Rolle.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst abwechslungsreiche Individualsoftware
  • Du setzt REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Fachverfahren und Drittsystemen um
  • Du übernimmst langfristige Verantwortung für laufende Anwendungen: Updates, Sicherheits-Patches, Performance-Optimierung und Monitoring
  • Du arbeitest mit einem modernen Stack: Laravel, Livewire, MySQL, Redis, Docker, FrankenPHP und Caddy, Azure/AWS
  • Du arbeitest nach Scrum mit DevOps-Boards, machst Code Reviews im Team
  • Du stimmst dich direkt mit unseren langjährigen Kunden ab

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung, ein Studium im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der PHP-Entwicklung
  • Wesentliche Beteiligung an mindestens zwei PHP-Softwareprojekten, die produktiv im Einsatz sind oder waren
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Laravel (Eloquent, Queues, Testing etc.)
  • Erfahrung mit mind. einem JavaScript-Framework wie Vue.js, React oder Alpine.js
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MySQL und sauberem Datenbankdesign
  • Docker Compose gehört zu deinem Entwickleralltag, Erfahrung mit Kubernetes ist ein Plus

data.title: People Business Partner
data.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

 

The Opportunity

As a People Business Partner, you will work closely with our Europe Engineering, Product & Design, and G&A teams, partnering with leaders and managers to support org health, talent strategy, and people programs that move the business forward. This role sits at an exciting intersection — you'll be deeply embedded with your European counterparts while also partnering closely with our US-based teams to help bridge and strengthen our global company.

  • Partner closely with leaders and managers across Europe Engineering, Product & Design, and G&A teams to support a full range of people situations (performance, org health, change management, etc)

  • Build strong relationships across your client groups — earning trust quickly and developing a deep understanding of the business context in Europe across multiple regions (Ukraine, Germany, Poland)

  • Serve as a key bridge between Europe and US counterparts, bringing a global lens to how we design and deliver people programs, and helping ensure our practices work well across geographies

  • Support talent processes, including performance management, talent reviews, and calibrations — partnering with managers to maintain a high and consistent bar

  • Collaborate with the broader People team (L&D, Compensation, Ops, Recruiting) to help run and deliver programs and projects that serve your client groups

  • Partner with leaders, finance, and recruiting on headcount planning and team structure conversations, translating business needs into the right people investments

 

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of people partner or HR business partner experience, ideally with exposure to global or multi-region companies

  • Experience supporting Engineering, Product, Design, and/or G&A orgs is preferred

  • Demonstrated ability to build high-trust relationships with managers and leaders, and to show up as a credible, strategic partner

  • Strong judgment in navigating employee situations with speed, structure, and genuine care

  • Understanding of the cultural and employment landscape across key European markets

  • Comfortable working across time zones and geographies — you understand what it takes to bridge a global company and bring people together

  • Experience partnering with other People teams and business partners like Finance and Recruiting

  • Ready to roll up your sleeves and figure out and build the right solutions with cross-functional partners, not just execute established processes

  • Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can operate proactively with independence

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Nice to Have:

  • Prior exposure to compensation review processes or pay equity analysis

  • Experience in a compound startup, multi-product company, or post-acquisition environment

     

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

     

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

data.title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer (f/m/d)
data.description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We thrive, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who thrive on ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision Engineer to join our computer vision team. You will design, implement, and deploy end-to-end computer vision pipelines for UAV perception, from data collection to real-time inference on embedded platforms. This includes working with multi-modal sensors, camera hardware, calibration workflows, and integrating perception systems tightly with UAV hardware and autonomy stacks. You will test in real environments, iterate using real-world data, and collaborate closely with mission partners and engineering teams.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Build and optimize computer vision pipelines for real-time onboard UAV processing.

  • Configure, calibrate, and integrate imaging sensors (RGB, thermal, stereo, depth, IR).

  • Develop, train, and evaluate deep learning models for detection, tracking, and classification.

  • Deploy models on edge devices; TensorRT and NVIDIA Jetson experience is a strong plus.

  • Apply classical CV concepts to complement DL solutions.

  • Work with real-world data collection, annotation, and performance benchmarking.

  • Integrate perception modules with ROS-based systems and UAV hardware.

  • Collaborate with hardware, autonomy, and mission teams for field deployment.


  • Degree in Computer Vision, Robotics, ML, EE, or related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in working in Robotics, AI, Deep tech or UAV systems related filed.

  • Excellent Python, ROS and C++ skills.

  • Strong experience with sensor fusion (eg. Kalman Filters).

  • Strong experience with PyTorch/TensorFlow or similar deep learning frameworks.

  • Strong ROS and OpenCV knowledge.

  • Hands-on experience with model deployment; TensorRT/Jetson is a plus.

  • Strong grounding in computer vision theory.

  • GStreamer and camera streaming experience is a plus.

  • Strong software engineering and Linux knowledge — Git, Docker, CI/CD.

  • Willingness to travel for field tests and deployments.

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

data.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The role

Customer Service Advisors are the first point of contact for potential customers as well as new and existing customers, and thus the “face” of iwoca. You handle incoming calls, emails and web chats, supporting entrepreneurs with general inquiries, new applications and repeat loans. You highly value our customer service and support customers with your excellent communication skills so they can successfully utilise our products.

A fundamental component for our success is to convince and inspire customers and partners of our mission - this ranges from hair salons and dental practices to financial advisory services and banks.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and always looking to improve.

  • You enjoy communicating with customers and live "customer centricity". Your greatest motivation is achieving success with our customers.

  • You have completed a commercial training / business studies (kaufmännische Ausbildung / betriebswirtschaftliches Studium) and can add value with relevant professional experience in customer service (experiences in the banking environment or a fintech are a plus).

  • You are highly motivated, organised, a true team player and have a 'hands-on' mentality.

  • You possess C1-level German communication skills (both written and spoken) and are comfortable collaborating in English within our diverse, international office.

  • An independent, team-oriented and reliable way of working is a given.

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

Your mission:

  • You are responsible for the overall customer satisfaction and ensure that customer inquiries via phone, email or web chat are handled promptly and efficiently.

  • You answer questions about our products, the application process and our service in general, supporting both new and existing customers.

  • You assist entrepreneurs in completing their applications and providing the necessary documents required for a credit decision.

  • You collaborate with various teams within iwoca to achieve the best outcome for our customers.

  • You proactively participate in the development of iwoca by providing regular insights on customer feedback, opportunities to improve our processes or new offerings from our competitors.

Work-life balance is incredibly important at iwoca and we offer flexible working so you can make better use of your free time. This is a hybrid role in which you can split your time between the office and home.

We want to make iwoca a place where everyone feels welcome, where you can confidently be yourself. We understand that inclusivity, and diversity that comes through greater inclusivity, isn't an optional add-on; it's the core ingredient of what makes us great. We care about making iwoca a healthy and happy community for all of our team members to thrive in.

The salary

We expect to pay from £28,000 — £36,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

As a Technical Web Specialist, you’ll be the connective tissue between our web team and the rest of the business. This role exists because great websites aren’t just built — they’re coordinated, prioritised, and protected from chaos. Sitting at the intersection of Marketing and Web Development, you’ll own the intake and lifecycle of web requests, ensure every project is properly scoped before it touches the dev queue, and support the team in delivering an ambitious web roadmap.

But this role doesn’t stop at coordination. You’ll also be hands-on in the quality of what we ship — reviewing copy and UX before pages go live, supporting CRO initiatives, and acting as a critical second pair of eyes on every significant release. You care as much about whether a page converts as whether it launches on time.

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, understands how a website is actually built, and can hold your own in a room with developers, designers, and marketers alike, this is your role.


What You’ll Do

Technical Ownership & QA

  • Build and ship pages/components directly in Storyblok CMS: component configuration, staging, QA, and production deployment across market versions

  • QA every release technically — rendering, functionality, and cross-browser/device behaviour, not just copy and visual polish

  • Use AI tools as a core part of daily production work (drafting, layout variants, QA support), and know where AI output still needs a human check, particularly around localisation nuance and experiment validity

Request Triage & Scoping

  • Own intake for web requests: qualify, triage, and estimate technical complexity and dependencies before anything is scoped or scheduled

  • Enforce briefing standards and know enough technically to explain why a brief is incomplete

  • Decide what can be handled directly vs. what needs to go to the development team, and write specs the team can act on without excessive clarification

Project Coordination

  • Act as day-to-day PM between the development team and business stakeholders: track scope, delivery, and risk

  • Maintain the web backlog and sprint board with clear status, ownership, and blockers

  • Support CRO initiatives: help build A/B test setups, document hypotheses, and track experiment results

Process & Reporting

  • Maintain intake templates, briefing standards, and triage criteria

  • Produce regular status updates and pipeline reports for the Head of Web and wider leadership


What We’re Looking For

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years in a web operations, technical/digital project management, or web production role, ideally with hands-on CMS or front-end exposure — not purely marketing coordination

  • Working technical literacy: solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, understanding of how a CMS is structured (Storyblok, Contentful, Webflow or similar), staging vs. production workflows, and what a QA process actually checks

  • Comfortable using AI tools hands-on in production (prompting for drafts, QA’ing AI output) and able to articulate where AI isn’t reliable enough to trust unsupervised

  • Product/project-management instincts: can scope a request, size complexity, sequence competing priorities, and brief external developers with minimal hand-holding

  • Confident translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and comfortable pushing back on a brief or a deadline when needed

  • Strong written communication: a clear brief, a precise QA note, a concise status update

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Storyblok or a comparable headless CMS

  • Familiarity with web analytics or conversion tracking concepts

  • Exposure to A/B testing/CRO tools, or basic SQL

  • Experience briefing or QA’ing a development team

  • Basic understanding of Core Web Vitals / page performance

  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals as they intersect with web production


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12–16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 “Work from Anywhere” days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

data.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About Us

CIM Software builds manufacturing and ERP software used by manufacturers across the UK and beyond. Our established products, Cim50 and Cim200, are the recommended manufacturing solutions for Sage 50 and Sage 200. We are also developing Cim360.cloud, a new SaaS ERP platform that takes our manufacturing expertise into the cloud.

We were acquired by Everfield in 2025, which gives us the stability and backing of a larger group while keeping the close-knit, hands-on culture of a specialist software company.

About the Role

This is a varied, hands-on role at the heart of a close-knit support desk. You will be one of the people our direct customers and reseller partners turn to when they need help, taking ownership of 1st and 2nd line cases across our full product range. No two days look quite the same: you will resolve what you can yourself and work with the wider team on the trickier problems, building your product knowledge as you go.

We are looking for someone with solid Sage 200 support experience who wants to broaden across our wider product range over time. There is genuine manufacturing ERP expertise to build here, and a clear path to grow as you develop and as we bring Cim360.cloud to market.

AI tooling is part of how we work, and you will be encouraged to use and build your skills with modern AI assistants as part of the day job.

What you will do

  • Work the incoming support queue, handling 1st and 2nd line cases across our product range for both direct customers and reseller partners, by phone, email, and ticket.

  • Work closely with the rest of the support team, lending your weight across the desk during busier periods to keep response times sharp for customers and partners.

  • Diagnose and resolve issues directly where possible, working from the knowledgebase and your growing product knowledge.

  • Investigate configuration and data issues, including running SQL queries where needed.

  • Escalate the more complex cases clearly, with good detail and reproduction steps.

  • Keep cases updated and communicate clearly with both customers and partners throughout.

  • Contribute to the knowledgebase so common issues become easier to resolve over time.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Solid, demonstrable Sage 200 support experience in a 1st or 2nd line role.

  • Strong customer service skills and clear written and verbal communication.

  • A methodical, calm approach to troubleshooting and case ownership.

  • Comfortable working with databases, with at least basic SQL skills.

Desirable

  • Exposure to Cim200, Sicon Manufacturing, or Sage 200 Manufacturing.

  • Understanding of manufacturing concepts (BOMs, works orders, stock control).

  • Experience supporting Sage or business software, whether in-house, for a software vendor, or at a Sage partner.

  • Confidence using AI tools to investigate issues and draft responses, with the appetite to develop these skills further.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working: office, hybrid, or fully remote to suit you.

  • A varied role spanning our full product range and both direct and partner customers.

  • A clear path to build deep, specialist manufacturing ERP knowledge and progress into more senior support.

  • Genuine opportunity to use, leverage, and skill up in modern AI tooling as a core part of the job, not a side experiment.

data.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to growth, we are seeking an experienced Events Lead to take complete ownership of our events programme and build CuspAI's events function from the ground up.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the global events engine that accelerates CuspAI and the AI Materials Foundry, which is critical for driving real-world impact of our work across international markets.

Your main focus initially will be executing our flagship in-person Foundry event and subsequent international roadshows across Asia and Europe. Over time you will build out a repeatable event model, assemble an agile agency and vendor network, and establish CuspAI’s experiential presence across global scientific and machine learning conferences. As the team scales, the function will also own internal events.

What You Will Do

Foundry Events & Global Roadshows

  • Own our flagship in-person Foundry event end to end, establishing the core gathering for our global partner network.

  • With our Partnerships team, design, plan, and deliver a regional roadshow of Foundry events across Asia, Europe and North America, creating a repeatable execution model for international expansion.

  • Establish and manage a regular cadence of virtual events to keep the global Foundry ecosystem engaged between physical moments.

Customer & Partner Experiences

  • With Comms/Marketing and Partnerships, conceptualise and execute high-touch events for industrial partners and enterprise customers (e.g. executive dinners, interactive virtual showcases, and partner roundtables).

  • Align event formats with commercial and ecosystem goals to deepen partner trust and engagement.

Conferences, Sponsorships & Internal Events

  • Own CuspAI's strategic presence at major industry and machine learning conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, and materials science summits).

  • Evaluate sponsorship packages, oversee booth design and recruitment stands, manage on-site logistics, and report on return on investment.

  • Partner with internal operations teams to help deliver internal company moments (e.g. CuspCon, company offsites, and all-hands).

Event Operations & Physical Brand Experience

  • Source, negotiate with, and direct external production agencies, AV suppliers, local vendors, and freelance event staff.

  • Partner closely with Communications, Product Marketing, and Creative teams to bring CuspAI's visual brand identity into physical spaces.

  • Own event budgets, timelines, and post-event analytics, providing clear reporting to leadership on performance and cost efficiency.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about enabling world-class scientists and industry partners to collaborate on global sustainability and materials challenges.

  • 5+ years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or event operations within a high-growth tech, deep-tech, or B2B environment.

  • Track record of delivering high-touch physical and virtual events internationally across EMEA and APAC regions.

  • Strong vendor management experience, with a history of sourcing, negotiating with, and directing production agencies, AV teams, and freelance staff.

  • Proven ability to balance strategic planning (e.g. budget management, roadmap design, ROI measurement) with hands-on, on-site event execution.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder skills, with experience collaborating directly with executive leadership, sales, partnerships, and creative teams.

  • Flexibility to undertake regular UK and international travel for events, conferences, and site visits.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment building an event function or operational processes from scratch.

  • Direct experience engaging scientific, research-led, or highly technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with event management software, virtual event tools, and CRM systems (e.g. HubSpot, event platforms).

  • An eye for spatial design, environmental branding, or experiential production.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 
 

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.

 

  • Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.

  • Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

  • Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

  • Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

  • Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

  • Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

  • Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

  • High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

  • Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.

  • A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

data.title: Research Scientist - 3D Reconstruction (SfM & SLAM)
data.description:
SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We're seeking a Research Scientist focused on 3D reconstruction. You will advance methods that recover accurate camera poses and geometry from real-world imagery, working with both classical multi-view geometry and state-of-the-art learned reconstructors. The work includes structure-from-motion, bundle adjustment, SLAM, or feed-forward reconstruction, with a focus on robustness, accuracy, and methods that hold up on diverse real-world data.

Responsibilities

  • Design camera pose estimators and 3D reconstructors.

  • Build robust SfM and camera tracking pipelines for a variety of input imaging sensors.

  • Develop bundle adjusters and nonlinear optimizers, including non-perspective camera formulations.

  • Integrate and extend SOTA feed-forward reconstructors (VGGT, DA3, Pi3)

  • Advance deep multi-view stereo, learned matching, and monocular depth methods for dense geometry.

  • Build evaluation metrics for pose accuracy and reconstruction quality, and drive improvements against public & internal benchmarks.

  • Scale reconstruction methods to large, diverse real-world datasets while keeping them reliable and efficient.

  • Collaborate with researchers to bring reconstruction advances into production systems.

Key Qualifications

  • PhD in computer vision with a research focus on 3D reconstruction; publications at top venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS).

  • Deep understanding of multi-view geometry: camera models, epipolar geometry, triangulation, PnP, etc.

  • Strong familiarity with SOTA deep reconstructors (VGGT, DA3, Pi3) and related areas such as deep MVS, learned matching, and monocular depth estimation.

  • Hands-on experience with SfM/SLAM systems (COLMAP, ORB-SLAM) and nonlinear least-squares solvers (Ceres).

  • Experience shipping production-grade 3D reconstruction systems is a strong plus.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills.

  • Comfortable debugging failure cases on challenging real-world data.

data.title: Research Scientist - Robot Learning (VLA / WAM)
data.description:
SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We're seeking a Research Scientist to train the policies that turn a world model into a robot that acts. You will own vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM) end to end, starting, including data, backbone, action representation, training runs, and the evaluation that tells us whether a policy is genuinely competent or merely lucky. A world model that understands geometry and physics still doesn't act on its own; the policy is what closes that gap. This is a senior, hands-on research role for someone who has already trained manipulation policies that worked, and who can say precisely why the ones that didn't failed.

Responsibilities

  • Own the training pipeline for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM) end to end, from data to a policy running on a robot.

  • Contribute to setting the technical direction for embodied research at SpAItial.

  • Close the sim-to-real gap through domain randomization, system identification, and calibration, and build evaluation that predicts real-world transfer.

  • Adapt VLM backbones for control: encoder choice and adapter strategies, co-training.

  • Curate and weight the training mix across heterogeneous robot datasets, spanning differing embodiments, action spaces, and sensor setups.

  • Design action representation and decoding, including tokenization, chunking, diffusion, and flow-matching action experts.

  • Build the world-model components that predict future observations conditioned on action.

  • Run post-training: supervised fine-tuning onto target embodiments, and RL for robustness beyond demonstrations.

Key Qualifications

  • A PhD in robotics, machine learning, or computer vision with a robot learning focus, from the PhD alone or followed by industry experience.

  • Publications at top venues such as (CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS or CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS), open-source work, and/or deployed systems.

  • Deep experience with modern robot policy designs (VLA, WAM, diffusion), trained end to end rather than fine-tuned from a released checkpoint.

  • Strong imitation learning fundamentals, and familiarity with RL fine-tuning of pretrained policies.

  • Fluency with VLM backbones and how to adapt them for control.

  • Expert Python and PyTorch, with multi-node distributed training experience (FSDP or equivalent).

data.title: Integrations Engineer
data.description:
Scope automates the data collection that’s slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We’re building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the world’s largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started, with ambitions. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We’ve assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by [Index Ventures] (https://www.indexventures.com/), the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with 100+ unicorns backed to date.

About the role

You will join a talented, flat-structured engineering team as our Integrations Engineer, owning how external systems interact with Scope’s platform. You will build the APIs, frameworks and data pipelines behind every integration, and own problems end to end. You will be the 1st Integrations Engineer hire and will build out the team as we scale.

You will not be siloed. You will work directly with our Deployment Strategists and clients to understand their systems, decide what to build, ship it and check it worked. Every integration you deliver should make the next one faster.

We work in person five days a week at our Farringdon office, because we believe it's how we move fastest.

We're looking for people who want to help reimagine what inspection software should look like in a post-AI world, and how it plugs into everything around it.

What you will do

  • Build the core foundations for integrations, including APIs that allow external systems to interact with our platform.

  • Develop reusable integration frameworks, from advanced custom integrations to no-code tools like Zapier and Make.

  • Work directly with Deployment Strategists and clients to integrate Scope into their existing systems.

  • Build reusable components so each integration makes the next faster and easier.

  • Build data pipelines for migrations and synchronisation with external systems.

  • Work closely with the engineering team to ensure integrations remain compatible as the platform evolves.

Who you are

  • Strong technical ability, particularly in backend engineering and APIs.

data.title: Data Scientist (Credit) - Car Finance
data.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

 

Car Finance at Marshmallow

Marshmallow is opening up access to credit to migrants, bringing a brand new product to market which provides newcomers to the UK with fairly priced car finance for the first time.

Our Car Finance team is building a new generation lending platform from the ground up, making it simple, transparent and accessible for people who need finance to get on the road. We work closely with dealers, brokers and customers to make sure that every application, decision and interaction is fast, fair and easy to understand.

Because we’re a small, high-performing team, everyone has real ownership. We combine hands-on operations with a strong focus on automation and technology. We’re designing highly automated, AI-powered processes that let us move faster and smarter than traditional lenders.

The Role

We're hiring a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we lend: who we say yes to, at what price, and how we know it's working.

Our customers are people that traditional lenders struggle to assess. Many are new to the UK, have thin or no credit files, and don't fit neatly into off-the-shelf bureau scores. That makes credit decisioning at Marshmallow a genuinely hard, genuinely interesting problem: we combine bureau data, Open Banking, insurance, application and behavioural data to build a view of risk that others can't, and we need to do it in a way that is fair, explainable and compliant.

This role sits between a traditional credit analyst and a data scientist. You'll build and monitor scorecards, design and test credit strategies, dig into portfolio performance to find out what's really going on, and turn large, messy datasets into insights that change how we lend. You'll own your work end-to-end: from framing the question and pulling the data through to modelling, presenting a recommendation and seeing it live in our decision engine.

You'll be working with a small team and a modern stack, alongside a Head of Credit who has built this function from scratch and who will give you real ownership from day one. This is not a role where you hand models over a wall and move on - you'll see the impact of your decisions immediately.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Build, validate and monitor application and behavioural scorecards, using bureau, Open Banking and internal data to improve how we assess new-to-UK and thin-file customers.

  • Design, test and refine our credit strategy: cut-offs, affordability rules, pricing tiers and limits, with a clear view of the trade-off between risk, volume and margin.

  • Run experiments and champion/challenge tests to prove that changes to policy and models actually work before we scale them.

  • Explore new data sources and alternative signals, and build the case for using (or not using) them in decisioning.

  • Support model governance: document what you build, evidence that it treats customers fairly, and help us meet our Consumer Duty, CONC and model risk obligations.

  • Work with our engineers to get models and rules into production, and use AI tooling to make yourself and the team faster.

What You'll Bring

Must have

  • 2–5 years' experience in decision science or data science within consumer lending or another regulated financial services environment.

  • Hands-on experience developing or materially refining credit scorecards or risk models (logistic regression and/or gradient boosting), including the practicalities: sample design, binning, reject inference, validation and monitoring.

  • Experience working with Open Banking or other alternative data in credit decisioning.

  • SQL user, and comfortable working with large, imperfect datasets.

  • A solid grounding in statistics and a good instinct for when a result is real and when it isn't.

  • Commercial judgement: you can translate a model output into a lending decision and explain the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You ask why, you dig until you find the answer, and you'd rather ship something and improve it than wait for perfection.

Nice to have

  • Motor finance or other secured lending experience.

  • Experience of working within a rapidly scaling lending environment.

  • Familiarity with UK consumer credit regulation and how it shapes model design and use.

  • Experience using LLMs to speed up analytical work.

  • You already know some of the tooling Marshmallow uses: Snowflake, Python, Claude, Linear, Notion

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

 

We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

 

Our process

  • Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)

  • Onsite interview consisting of:

    • Technical interview with a couple of the team (60 mins)

    • Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

About us

The product mindset on this team is different from most of the company: short-term product insight matters less, long-term matters a lot. Foundations plans around how the next 6, 12, and 24 months will look, with an overarching shape to the problem: handling multiple orders of magnitude the data we handle today.

Encord is growing rapidly, with our product as the key driver of that growth. A year ago, we were a team of 100; now, we're over 150 and continuing to accelerate. The systems that got us here won't get us to what's next. That's the problem you'll help solve.

data.title: Senior IC PDK Development Engineer
data.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing start-up based in London. We are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. We operate out of state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities in Islington and bring together an outstanding interdisciplinary team spanning quantum physics to IC design. 


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC, and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We are backed by a world-class group of investors including Bosch Ventures, Porsche SE, Sony Innovation Fund, Oxford Science Enterprises, INKEF Capital, and Octopus Ventures. 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians, and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working closely together to maximize our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Sydney, San Sebastian & Maryland (US) with our main hub in our Islington lab. 


Functions of the Role

The primary function of this position will be to architect, build, and maintain our custom process design kits (PDKs) and physical verification enablements. In this role, you will sit within the IC Design team, serving as the critical bridge between foundry technologies, custom cryogenic silicon devices, and our circuit design group.
You will create custom PDK components from scratch and enable novel silicon spin-qubit and cryo-CMOS circuit design methodologies. No prior background in quantum physics is required.

  • Development of custom PDK elements from scratch, including Schematic symbols, Layout SKILL PCells, and custom DRC and LVS decks.
  • Development, qualification, and maintenance of custom Calibre SVRF rule decks tailored for non-standard layout constraints and cryogenic CMOS layout considerations.
  • Integrate tier-1 foundry PDKs into Cadence Virtuoso, creating customized library extensions, layer maps, and device callbacks.
  • Work closely with IC designers and layout engineers to establish best practices for physical verification and layout automation.
  • Document own work for peer review and evaluate the layout and enablement work of other team members.


Experience - Essentials

  • Industry degree qualification in Electronic Engineering, IC Layout, Computer Science, or a related physical science/engineering field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in IC PDK Development and PDK enablement flow management.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Cadence SKILL PCell coding and Virtuoso PDK customization.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Siemens Calibre Physical Verification tools and SVRF Rule writing (specifically for DRC and LVS decks).
  • Proven hands-on experience in complex DRC and LVS error debugging within analog/mixed-signal or custom digital layout environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of self-management, self-motivation, and willingness to engage actively in peer code and layout reviews.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary physics and IC engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

  • Demonstrated experience with advanced deep-submicron CMOS nodes (40nm, 28nm, or below), including familiarity with layout-dependent effects (LOD, WPE, OSE, etc.).
  • Expert knowledge of the Cadence Virtuoso Design Environment and Cadence SKILL / SKILL++ programming.
  • Expert knowledge of the Siemens Calibre Physical Verification Environment.
  • Familiarity with MOSFET device modeling integration (e.g., BSIM, Verilog-A) or cryogenic device enablement. 
  • General awareness or curiosity regarding semiconductor quantum dots or silicon spin qubit fundamentals. 


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team
  • Competitive salary and share options scheme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Life Assurance
  • Cycle-to-work Scheme
  • Flexible working
  • Central London location (Islington)


EEO Statement

Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment, or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010.

data.description:
Intro

Als SaaS-Unternehmen ist unsere Commerce-Plattform unser Herzstück. Mit ihr ermöglichen wir Herstellern im Automotive Aftermarket den digitalen Handel und vernetzen komplexe Strukturen. Während unsere Plattform wächst und die Anforderungen steigen, wächst auch die Komplexität unserer hybriden Infrastruktur. Um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Systeme durch intelligente Automation und operative AI nicht nur stabiler laufen, sondern auch vorausschauender und effizienter werden, kommst du ins Spiel. Dein Impact ist direkt spürbar: bessere Verfügbarkeit, weniger manuelle Eingriffe, klarere Abläufe und eine Plattform, die heute zuverlässig funktioniert und morgen weiteres Wachstum trägt. Bock unser technisches Fundament auf das nächste Level zu heben und den technischen Backbone für eine hochverfügbare, sichere und skalierbare Zukunft zu bauen? Dann let's go!


Deine Rolle

Du gestaltest und verantwortest das technische Fundament, das unsere Plattform zuverlässig, sicher und skalierbar macht.

  • Hybride Infrastruktur: Du entwickelst unsere Umgebung aus Cloud- und On-Prem-Systemen weiter und sorgst für Stabilität, Performance und Skalierbarkeit.

  • Automation First: Du reduzierst manuelle Eingriffe durch saubere Skripte, Standards und Self-Service-Lösungen für unsere Teams.

  • Stabiler Betrieb: Du stärkst die Zuverlässigkeit unserer Plattform durch besseres Monitoring, mehr Observability und ein strukturiertes Incident-Management.

  • Nachhaltige Lösungen: Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund (Root Cause Analysis), um sie dauerhaft zu lösen, anstatt nur Symptome zu behandeln.

  • Security by Design: Du verankerst Sicherheit als Standard im Betriebsalltag durch Hardening, Patch-Management und nachvollziehbare Zugriffskonzepte.

  • Pragmatischer AI-Einsatz: Du integrierst AI und Agenten gezielt in den Betrieb, um Analysen zu beschleunigen, bei Incidents zu unterstützen und wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu automatisieren.



Dein Profil

  • Starkes Fundament: Du hast mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung in DevOps, Systemadministration, Infrastruktur oder Platform Engineering, idealerweise im SaaS- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.

  • Tech-Stack: Du bist in hybriden Umgebungen zuhause, bringst praktische Erfahrung mit AWS oder Azure mit und beherrschst den sicheren Betrieb von On-Prem-Systemen (Linux, Netzwerke).

  • Automation-first: Du lebst und atmest Automatisierung und bringst exzellente Scripting-Skills (z.B. Bash, Python, Ansible) mit.

  • AI-Mindset: Du setzt AI gezielt für Aufgaben wie Analyse, Scripting oder Incident-Support ein und bewertest dabei klar den Unterschied zwischen Nutzen und Risiko.

  • Ownership: Du bist hands-on, übernimmst Verantwortung und treibst deine Themen proaktiv, selbstständig und mit Weitblick zum Erfolg.

  • Analytische Stärke und Problemlösung: Du findest das Signal im Rauschen, löst komplexe Probleme systematisch und hast den Anspruch, Dinge langfristig robuster zu machen statt kurzfristig zu flicken.

  • Starke Kommunikation: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch und kannst komplexe technische Themen einfach erklären.


...there is an extra smile ツ from us, when...

  • … du dich mit Monitoring, Backup/Restore und/oder Security-Hardening im Zeitalter von AI auskennst.
  • ... du bereits Erfahrung mit Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code oder containerisierten Workloads gesammelt hast.
  • ... du schon an API-first- oder stark integrationsgetriebenen Plattformen gearbeitet hast.
  • ... du schon interne Copilots, Ops-Agenten oder tool-nutzende Workflows mit klaren Guardrails aufgesetzt hast.


Unsere Benefits

  • Du musst jedem Tag mit deiner Arbeitsumgebung zurechtkommen, daher hast du die Wahl ob Windows, macOS oder Linux
  • Du erhältst 50 Euro steuerfreie Sachbezüge in Form der Givve Card
